scope: Close gemini-2-5-pro convergent critique: make spec MANDATORY in exec-verify.js (no agent-authored --expect fallback for new scripts).

provenance.structural_change: exec-verify.js now refuses if no spec exists at environment/verification/specs/<name>.spec.json. --expect CLI flag is still accepted as a no-op when spec provides stdout_regex, but cannot be used as a fallback when no spec exists. Closes the gemini-2-5-pro gap: agents cannot verify a new script by providing a permissive --expect regex.
